verses.text: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te ow jun yahelal ix och t'a winhaj Ezequías, wanxo scham winh. Ha inxo Isaías in schekab' Dios yuninal in winhaj Amoz, ix in k'och t'a winh, ix walan t'a winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Alkani tas ol ajkan tastak ay t'ayach, yujto ol ach chamxonhej, manhxo ol ach b'oxok, xin chi t'a winh.
Ix meltzajoch k'elan winh t'a sat spat, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová icha tik:
Tzin tewi t'ayach Mamin Jehová, nakoti tas ix wutej ach wak'an serwil t'a smasanil in k'o'ol, ix in k'ulejnhej tas ix scha a k'o'ol, xchi winh. Ix te ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin
to sb'at walxi t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal winh a mam icham aj David, a tz'alan icha tik: Ix wab' a lesal, ix wilanpax ok'i, yuj chi' ol wak' 15 ab'ilokxo a k 'inal.
Ol ach in kol yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria. Ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: --Ha jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová chi' to yel ol elk'och tas ix yala':

Ha juntzanh b'akhkiltak sch'oxan jantak yek' k'u yik winhaj Acaz, ol yak'xi meltzaj Jehová lajunhe'ok b'akhkiltak b'aj toxo ix emk'och wewen, xin chi. Yuj chi' ix scha'el yich yemxi lajunhe' b'akhkiltak wewen chi'.
Ayik toxo ix b'oxi sk'ol winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi', ix sb'o'an jun b'it tik winh:
Ha in na'ani to tek'an hinto ol in chamok. Yujto ix alchaj t'ayin to ayinxo'och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ha in na'ani to manhxo ol wil jaye'okxo ab'il.
Mamin Jehová, ix in na' to manhxo ol ach wil t'a sat lum tik. Manhxo ol wilpax junok heb' kajan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik walani,

yujto a in k 'inal ijan ix sateli, icha tz'aj sjuanem smantiado heb' tanhwum kalnel. Ha in k 'inal tik, lajan icha tz'aj spolji'elta k'apak k'apak b'aj sb'o'i. T'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ix wab' sya'il u'uj.
Ix el wal waw yuj sya'il tzek' ak'wal, ichato a junok nok' choj skach'an wekchaj in b'akil. T'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ix wab'nhej sya'il u'uj.
k'unxonhej yel waw icha nok' sanhkapech, ix in k'akwi icha nok' paramuch. Ix in tzaktzaj in tanhwan a paktzitan t'ayin. Mamin Jehová, tzin ixtax wal swab'i, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Haxo tikne'ik, ¿tas wach' walan t'ayach? Yujto ix ak' a ti' to tzin ak' b'oxok, icha chi' ix in utej. Emnakilal wek' tikne'ik yuj in yahelal ix ek' tik.
Mamin, yujnhej tas tza k'ulej, ay sk'inal heb' anima, ay pax in k 'inal yet' heb'. Ha ach ix ak' b'oxok in k'o'ol, ix ak'anxi in k 'inal.

Ayik ix jawi jun yahelal tik t'a wib'anh, ix in te kusi, haxo tikne'ik, junk'olal waji. Ix el t'a a k'ol ix in a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, yujto ix b'atkan in mul satk'olal u'uj, ichato ix ak'kanb'at t'a a patik.

Ha heb' ayxo'ek' t'a kampusante, maxtzak yal yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' chamnak chi', ¿tom ol ach yik'cha'anh heb'? Ha mach toxo ix emkan t'a yol lu'um, ¿tom olto yal stanhwan heb' ak'anelk'och tas ix al t'a heb'?
Anhej heb' pitzan syal yalan wach' lolonel t'ayach, icha tz'aj walan t'ayach tikne'ik. Ha heb' mamab'il nunab'il, a heb' tz'alan t'a heb' yalyuninal to tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ha Jehová ko Kolumal yaji, yuj chi' yakb'an pitzan onh, konh b'itanek t'a stemplo yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it, xchi winhaj Ezequías chi'.
Ix in chekan b'ojok sat te' higo, yik tz'ak'chajoch te' t'a sat jun yab'il chi', yik sb'oxi sk'o'ol winh yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'ayin icha tik: --¿Tas junok yechel ol wila' yik ol nachajel wuj to a Jehová ol ak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol, yik syal in b'at t'a stemplo? xchi winh.
